title: Posterior Neck Self-Massage
summary: The fingers glide gently down the back of the neck toward the shoulders without pressure on the front of the neck.
goal: Gently ease the feeling of tension after static posture.
startingPosition: Sit stably, lower the shoulders, and keep the head neutral.
instructions: Place the fingers on the back of the neck.
Glide gently downward toward the shoulders.
Do not press the front or side of the neck.
direction: Down the back of the neck toward the shoulders.
warning: Stop self-massage with pain, numbness, weakness, dizziness, radiating sensations, or other unusual symptoms.
